items.quote: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;
items.claim: The text says God remembered Noah and the animals in the ark, then sent a wind over the earth, and the flood waters went down.
items.action: remembered Noah and made a wind to pass over the earth
items.object: Noah, every living thing, the cattle in the ark; the flood waters

items.quote: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;
items.claim: The text says the fountains of the deep and the windows of heaven were closed, and the rain stopped.
items.object: fountains of the deep, windows of heaven, rain from heaven
items.mechanism: stopping the sources of the flood water

items.quote: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.
items.claim: The text says the waters kept draining off the earth, and by the end of 150 days they had gone down.
items.action: returned from off the earth continually; were abated
